QuestInfo.name: Stylist Vincent V
QuestInfo.0: Vincent wants to style a flashy blonde wig that you got for Vicky. What crazy hairdo will he concoct? Talk to him to find out.
QuestInfo.1: You make the wig into something truly special. Bring it to Vicky.
QuestInfo.2: Vicky is once again in love with the wig you helped Vincent make. This outfit is getting out of control... You worry the judges will laugh in Vicky's face.

0.0: All ready! OMG it's so perfect it's going to blind my eyes! Bring this to Vicky!

yes.0: Handle it with care when you hand it to Vicky. It's very delicate.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: A wig this time, huh? How original.

yes.0: A blonde wig, huh? Well, I was hoping to keep my own violet hair color...
yes.1: But whatevs. I know I can work it in any hair color. Awww yeaaahhh!

npc.0: Hurry, bring the wig to Vicky.

item.0: Well, I do need a flashy hairstyle. I just hope Vincent did a good job.
